items.title: Warren Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 17, 2018
items.q: some of my first orchestral experience other than high school and grade school was playing in Captain Dyett’s summer orchestra

ctx.x: And Captain Dyett had a summer concert orchestra, and some of my first orchestral experience other than high school and grade school was playing in Captain Dyett’s summer orchestra. And that was a wonderful experience you know. But music was always a constant. We had stacks of old 78 rpm records and we were listening to all kinds of music. We would listen to Debussy and all the classical artists as well as all the jazz music that was coming out then.
Can you remember your first paying gig?
